title: Agent Brain configuration (schema 1)
description: Used for the user file, .agent-brain/config.json and .agent-brain/config.local.json. Precedence: per-call > config.local.json > config.json > user file > built-in defaults. Relative paths resolve against the directory of the file that declares them.

inheritUser.description: Project files only. false ignores the user file entirely (reproducible CI, shared repos).

packages.description: Package (or engine, e.g. unity) name to concrete version.

collections.description: Local collections by collection ID. A higher level replaces a same-named entry whole; enabled: false removes it.

allowExternalDecisions.description: Allow this collection's entry text (titles, summaries, tags, excerpts) to be sent to the decision model. Without it the collection is judged by heuristics only.

connections.description: Remote Agent Brain hosts by name. A higher level replaces a same-named entry whole; enabled: false removes it.

url.description: https, or http on loopback only.

credentialEnv.description: Name of the environment variable holding the API key. Never the key itself.

forward.description: Project context sent to this connection. Everything is off by default.

writes.description: Where saves go by default. memory is project-only; knowledge may also be set in the user file.

memory.description: Project memory: memories, uncertainties, reports and notes. Needs maintain.

knowledge.description: Reusable knowledge. A local collection with maintain or propose, or a collection served by a connection.

sourcePreference.description: Collection IDs and connection names, preferred first, for fetching duplicate identities.

relaxation.description: strict, default, broad, or a number in [0, 1] written as a string.

log.description: Opt-in local query log for calibration.

decisions.description: Which implementation answers each judgement (ADR 0010). Every port defaults to its heuristic; no model is contacted unless a port says jev or hybrid.

apiKeyEnv.description: Name of the environment variable holding the key, never the key.

model.description: A versioned model ID. Aliases such as jev-latest move and are warned about.

relevancePool.description: Candidates the relevance judge may score per search; the candidate limit is raised to this.

aliases.description: Equivalence groups: term to equivalent terms. Union across levels; the higher level wins a term.

runtimeDir.description: Project files only. Git-ignored runtime data directory. Default: local

proposals.description: Project files only. Durable local proposals. Default: proposals

forwardContext.description: false forwards no project context to any connection.
